purpose: Improve scope transfer without shared normalized evaluation inputs
historical_overlap: Five ordinary inputs shared in review-03 train/dev/cal; old scores diagnostic only
selection: Same per-language formal/conversational development recall target >=99 percent; minimize worst-group false-review rate; final calibration audit after epoch selection
threshold_numerical_guard: Multiply the selected development cutoff by 1-1e-4 to tolerate small exported float32/float64 inference drift; this is not a statistical coverage guarantee
